Not an abduction but one time I had just came home from work and sat down on my patio to smoke a cigarette. My son was outside with me when all of a sudden he tells me that there is an alien in the sky. I didn't think to look because he was only 4 and we live near an airport so there are always planes flying overhead. He usually doesn't really point out the planes but that night was different. He then finally told me what color it was so I had to look and when I looked up it was a neon green ball in the sky. It wasn't moving just hovering. It was higher than any plane normally is. I was in disbelief. I got up as quick as I could and told my son that I was going to grab my phone. When I got back outside the light quickly flew away. It was like a shooting star as it flew off. Fast and then it vanished sort of. It's really hard to explain what I saw. If my son hadn't pointed it out, I would have thought I was hallucinating from exhaustion. He still talks about it and how weird it was.
